title: Inside Cabrillo Marine Aquarium’s New Jelly Lab
description:
Step inside L.A.’s hidden underwater world and explore the stunning new Jelly Tunnel at Cabrillo Marine Aquarium.

Visitors can explore a maze of habitats, from coastal exhibits to the brand-new Jelly Lab. This state-of-the-art space raises baby jellies for research and education, giving guests the chance to walk through a “jelly tunnel” for a close-up look at beautiful purple-striped and moon jellies.

For 90 years, Cabrillo Marine Aquarium has served as a gateway to the Pacific, connecting the community with the vibrant marine life found right off our shores. This local gem is more than an attraction. It is a center for education and conservation that brings people of all backgrounds together.

Behind the scenes, a high-tech pump house helps ensure every animal receives the highest quality care. Whether you are learning about whales or watching jellies pulse in the light, the aquarium offers a peaceful glimpse into Southern California’s diverse marine world.

Come celebrate nearly a century of ocean discovery and help protect the incredible animals that call our coast home.

Visit the aquarium: https://cma.recreation.parks.lacity.gov/
